device_name: Turbocharger Kit (Including an Optional Intercooler) for 2.8 Liter Toyota Supra and Cressida Vehicles
description: An add-on turbocharger kit, using a 0.98 A/R ratio Ishikawajima-Harima Heavy Industries turbocharger with an optional intercooler, for Toyota vehicles with a 2.8 liter (168 CID) fuel-injected six-cylinder engine.
notes: 9-page document (2-page EO plus 7-page staff evaluation report dated October 26, 1984). This order updates prior Executive Order D-140-1 (dated Feb 6, 1984) to add 1985 model-year coverage via new Turbo Kit No. 9909-A; D-140-1 is explicitly superseded. 'induction' is set to NA for all rows since the kit is an aftermarket add-on turbocharger installed on vehicles that are naturally aspirated from the factory; the document does not use the induction field terminology itself. Executed date read from handwritten '14th' over a typed blank on page 2.
